SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-03-2019 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF AMY MCKAY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC, REPRESENTED BY LLOYD GOLDFARB, FIELD CLAIMS INVESTIGATOR IS PRESENT. PG&E STATES THAT THIS MATTER IS STAYED DUE TO ITS BANKRUPTCY STATUS. PLAINTIFF IS PROVIDED FORM 410 IN ORDER TO FILE A CLAIM WITH US BANKRUPTCY COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MCKAY, AMY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY CLAIM IS STAYED BECAUSE OF BANKRUPTCY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
